linkedin_post.body:
When we started Purity Beans, I thought the rule was simple: make a pure instant coffee with zero chicory, price it fairly at Rs 18 per cup, and let the taste speak for itself.

Turns out, the retail shelf is rigged against you.

Incumbents with decades of dominance don't compete on purity. They compete on margin. And chicory root filler is the easiest way to pad margins.

When you walk down the coffee aisle, you aren't just looking at coffee. You are looking at decades of habituation built on cheap root fillers.

Launching a clean-label FMCG brand means fighting an uphill battle against shelf-space gatekeepers who ask: 'Where is the cheap filler to boost our margins?'

Our answer has always been simple: zero chicory. No compromise.

It makes distribution harder. It makes retail placement a daily negotiation. But when a customer opens a jar of Purity Beans and tastes actual coffee for the first time without the bitter muddy aftertaste of fillers, every distribution headache vanishes.

Quality wins eventually. But you have to survive the shelf wars first.

blog_post.body_html:
Why Reading Your Coffee Label Matters

When you buy packaged food in India, checking the back of the pack is the first step to knowing what you consume. Most instant coffee blends list chicory root as a filler, sometimes up to 40% of the content. This roasted root adds bulk but dilutes coffee flavor and aroma. Purity Beans labels clearly state: 100% coffee, zero chicory, no hidden ingredients.

What to Look For on the Label

  1. Ingredient list – The first item should be "coffee" or "instant coffee". If you see "chicory", "chicory root", or "roasted chicory", the product contains filler.
  2. Additives section – Look for preservatives, anti‑caking agents, or artificial flavors. Purity Beans contains none.
  3. Nutritional facts – Pure coffee has negligible carbohydrates and zero added sugar. High carb counts often indicate chicory fillers.
  4. Certifications – FSSAI license number and any purity seals help verify claims.

How Purity Beans Keeps It Pure

Our beans are sourced from trusted Indian estates, roasted, ground, and freeze‑dried without adding chicory, preservatives, or fillers. The label on every jar reads simply: "Ingredients: 100% Coffee". We also print the website https://p3online.in so you can learn more about our sourcing and process.

Make the Switch Today

Next time you shop, take five seconds to scan the ingredient panel. Choose brands that list only coffee. With Purity Beans, you get a pure cup at roughly Rs 18 per serving — ten times cheaper than a cafe coffee and completely transparent.

Ready to try 100% pure coffee? Visit https://p3online.in to order Purity Beans and experience coffee without compromise.
